caption: The drawing depicts a stagecoach with a rectangular carriage body that is primarily painted a light green color, with a darker green roof and lower trim. The words "OVERLAND STAGE" are written across the top side of the carriage, with "U.S. MAIL" on the front upper right. The coach has four large wagon wheels, each with red rims and hubs, and green spokes. The undercarriage, axles, and footboard are also red. There is a long wooden shaft in front, colored red, for attaching draft animals, and a short chain hanging from the end. The coach has three windows on the visible side and a small window at the back, with the front window showing a curtain in purple and white. There are thin vertical handrails on both sides of a green door at the side base of the carriage. The interior and window sections are shown in brown. The overall composition is set against a plain beige background with some faint discolorations.
title: Wooden Model of Overland Stage
